content: OPEN THREAD: Second compass paper — Cross-Architecture Generalization of Epistemic Posture Routing. Design: same 3B Ministral compass + v0.9 LoRA, three action models (Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated, Gemma-4-8B, Ministral-14B-abliterated), same 800 HumaneBench questions per model, same Stack context. Measurements: signal distribution per architecture, judge win rate per architecture, token-level entropy delta per architecture, response length distribution, thinking contamination rate. Hypothesis: compass delta is architecture-independent but magnitude varies with attention mechanism type — Gemma (dense attention) may show stronger delta than Qwen (hybrid linear) based on R×E superadditive interaction found in Relational Coupling Experiment. Negative result is equally publishable: if delta vanishes on one architecture, that constrains the mechanism to attention-type-specific effects. Prerequisites: (1) Complete Qwen HumaneBench 800 (verify overnight run), (2) Run Gemma-8B through same 800, (3) Run Ministral-14B through same 800, (4) Entropy profiling on all three. Estimated compute: ~8 hours total on M4 Max. Target: Zenodo DOI, fifth in the provenance chain.
